steps.title: Identify Moto Hill Racer Crash Cause
steps.description: Analyze existing files to determine the launch crash cause. Identified NullPointerException in GameView's onDraw method due to uninitialized collectibles list before starting a game.

steps.title: Implement Multiple Constructors in GameView
steps.description: Declare standard constructor signatures (context-only, context with attributes, context with defStyle) for robust XML inflation and component lifecycle handling.

steps.title: Add Null Check for Collectibles in onDraw
steps.description: Guard the collectible item rendering loop inside onDraw with a proper null-safety check, resolving the instant launch crash.

steps.title: Add Null Check in updatePhysics
steps.description: Secure the physics simulation loop in GameView with defensive check for active collectible items, preventing future concurrency or setup race condition crashes.

steps.title: Add Lifecycle Handler Release
steps.description: Override onDetachedFromWindow to remove callbacks from the Handler to avoid memory leaks and background task exceptions after layout destruction.

steps.title: Validate manifest parameters
steps.description: Verify xml namespaces, activity registrations, and reference icons inside AndroidManifest.xml to avoid deployment failures.

steps.title: Verify build target parameters
steps.description: Verify local gradle compiler parameters support target SDK 34 and JVM 1.8 compatibility layers.

steps.title: Building Moto Hill Racer
steps.description: Execute build compiler and output production debug artifacts.
